  JOIN affected_modules a ON m.object_id = a.module_id
),
affected_production_services AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT sim.subject_id AS service_id
  FROM service_implements_module sim
  JOIN affected_modules am ON sim.object_id = am.module_id
  JOIN service_deployed_to_deployment sdt ON sdt.subject_id = sim.subject_id
  JOIN task_targets_deployment ttd ON ttd.object_id = sdt.object_id AND ttd.subject_id = 'task:fx07-cutover'
),
relevant_boundaries AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT scb.object_id AS boundary_id
  FROM service_crosses_boundary scb
  JOIN affected_production_services aps ON aps.service_id = scb.subject_id
)

      SELECT DISTINCT scb.subject_id
      FROM service_crosses_boundary scb
      JOIN affected_production_services aps ON aps.service_id = scb.subject_id
      JOIN relevant_boundaries rb ON rb.boundary_id = scb.object_id
      ORDER BY scb.subject_id
